searchText: Yea, just ignore anything weird from validators 204000-208999. Goerli is the first Deneb testnet for us, sorry for inconvenience. FYI we're making ~25k deposits to get over the current churn rate on goerli. The current churn limit is already at the max allowed: `MAX_PER_EPOCH_ACTIVATION_CHURN_LIMIT: 8` churn of 9 validators per epoch requires 589824 active validators, allowing 2025 validators per day. So we'd need 23898 new validators to trigger the limit. This should take ~2 weeks to onboard, so we'll have results before we do anything on mainnet 🙂 <@334704997122179072> are you still spamming? RAM usage has been really high compared to "before" spamming begun. some clients experienced a 300% increase https://grafana.observability.ethpandaops.io/d/MRfYwus7k/nodes?orgId=1&refresh=1m&var-consensus_client=All&var-execution_client=All&var-network=dencun-devnet-12&var-filter=ingress_user%7C%21~%7Csynctest.%2A&viewPanel=9&from=now-7d&to=now Bit hard to see from the image, but you should be able to split up and see different EL/CL combos and how much memory each pair was using There is a clear spike at 13:50 UTC wednesday <@334704997122179072> we just rolled a new release of Reth to devnet-12 where we introduced default on-disk blob store, could you please keep spamming for a while? 😁

excerpts.author: parithosh
excerpts.content:
FYI we're making ~25k deposits to get over the current churn rate on goerli.

The current churn limit is already at the max allowed:
`MAX_PER_EPOCH_ACTIVATION_CHURN_LIMIT: 8`

churn of 9 validators per epoch requires 589824 active validators, allowing 2025 validators per day.

So we'd need 23898 new validators to trigger the limit. This should take ~2 weeks to onboard, so we'll have results before we do anything on mainnet 🙂
